content: Billing-cycle / fixed-cycle progress visualization conventions: subscription renewal bars show elapsed portion of cycle with countdown text ('resets in Xh'); CodexBar menu card shows countdown by default with optional absolute clock; pace tracking compares actual usage vs even-consumption rate showing 'X% in deficit' / 'X% in reserve' with 'Runs out in...' vs 'Lasts until reset' labels, hidden until 3% of window elapsed; onWatch (Go daemon) forecasts quota exhaustion before next reset and detects early resets as anomalies. A marker-on-bar showing elapsed time in a fixed cycle is NOT found in any competitor — it is the project's differentiating composition.
